implementation_kind: original mlx2 implementation of a paper algorithm
license: Paper: CC BY 4.0; original mlx2 implementation: Apache-2.0
modifications: Implement shared causal featureless spine and all acceptance-boundary bidirectional branches with one real MLX backbone forward
Assign nonmonotonic repeated absolute RoPE positions through batched per-token offsets
Retain immutable per-layer KV projected from committed target features; publish only previous anchor plus accepted draft positions
Separate bonus-independent backbone outputs from previous-token low-rank Markov head finalization
Export the exact transformed sequential proposal laws to the ordinary rejection verifier
Bind branch handles and context to request, target revision, draft revision and generation; consume or discard exactly once
Reject public handles with unrelated context, spine or branch binding; optionally pin caller-expected target and draft revisions before model allocation
Provide explicit executor scheduling with cancellation and failed-verification cleanup
Refuse ordinary DFlash/DSpark checkpoint metadata; require multiple-anchor featureless marker and a pinned converted artifact manifest
Keep this single-request full-attention candidate outside selected serving and APCv2 publication
Handle empty committed context without launching normalization or RoPE on null Metal buffers

validation.result: 46 passed in 0.44s (2026-10-01); ruff check and format passed for all five Python files
evidence: Every tree branch matches an independent separate-prefix attention/RoPE oracle, including empty context
Rejected spine suffix cannot influence the selected branch
All acceptance boundaries and several actual bonus tokens match independent Markov-head greedy results
Conditional proposal laws match independent host softmax and target rejection-sampling distribution
Only accepted target-feature KV is appended; previous context remains unchanged
Stale request/revision/generation and repeated resolve fail closed
CPU event barriers demonstrate independent scheduling, including cancellation during precompute and finalization
Synthetic converted artifact roundtrip and manifest tampering rejection
Empty-context M3 Metal tree and independent-prefix oracle passed for draft lengths2/3; regression test forbids empty normalization

limitations: No compatible trained M-DFlash artifact was acquired; synthetic tensors do not establish acceptance quality or model qualification
This does not register a serving route or publish approximate/branch state through APCv2
Single request, full attention, default split-half RoPE; no sliding windows, tree batching or distributed transport
Logical executor concurrency is not evidence of Apple GPU concurrency or speedup
Checkpoint marker is a compatibility declaration, not proof of training or qualification
